hero.title: La Calerilla
hero.subtitle: The shooting ground of Los Collados de San Miguel: the tradition of red-legged partridge walked-up, in the heart of La Mancha.

intro: La Calerilla is the estate’s shoot, in the natural landscape of Campos de Montiel, where the red-legged partridge (Alectoris rufa) finds the right habitat among scrub, olive groves and cereal fields.

blocks.title: A shooting tradition in La Mancha
paragraphs: From October to February we enjoy shooting days in country that is perfect for keeping the partridge tradition alive in its different forms, with particular care for walked-up shooting.
La Calerilla is the right stage for those who want authenticity, respect for the land and birds whose flight is striking for its height and verticality.

blocks.title: Walked-up shooting and other forms
paragraphs: Walked-up shooting lets you cover the ground at an unhurried pace, with pointing dogs, in the rhythm of the La Mancha countryside. A way of understanding the sport that is bound to the landscape, to company and to knowledge of the ground.
If you wish to book a shooting day, we recommend getting in touch as early as you can: season dates are in high demand. We can combine the day with bungalow lodging and our traditional cooking.

blocks.title: Dining, comfort and nature
paragraphs: After the day in the field, the estate welcomes the guns with the comfort of its rooms: dining with dishes such as partridge salad in escabeche, migas manchegas and produce of the land.

The surroundings are rich in native fauna and flora. A visit to La Calerilla is not only about the shoot: it is a living landscape where rural tourism, farming and the shooting culture of Castilla-La Mancha sit side by side.
